How can we help you?

Algo Trading, short for algorithmic trading, refers to the use of computer algorithms to execute trading orders in financial markets.

Algo trading works on engines that receive and process market data in real-time using mathematical models and technical indicators.

Algo trading can be profitable, but it depends on various factors such as the effectiveness of the trading strategy and market conditions.

Yes, algo trading is legal in India. SEBI has established guidelines and regulations for algo trading.
